title: TiAb Review: a Chrome extension and web app for title/abstract and full-text screening in systematic reviews
description: TiAb Review supports title/abstract and full-text screening for systematic reviews, using a shared Google Sheets spreadsheet as the database. It offers independent (blinded) screening by multiple reviewers, conflict resolution, active-learning prioritisation, optional AI screening as an additional screener, and draft Methods/Results text with PRISMA 2020 flow numbers. Release notes for each version are in CHANGELOG.md.
notes: Developed with support from JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number 25K13585. Distributed through the Chrome Web Store; web version at https://youkiti.github.io/tiab-review-plugin/app/.
